dogecoin.text: @TremaineWills @dogecoin I don’t understand much of it either, so I figure I’ll use it as a teaching moment over the next year (bought in last week, so too late for this semester). My “interesting choices” often lead to better discussions in the classroom. 🤣 “Don’t do what Dr. M did!” 🤣🤣🤣

@TremaineWills For the first time we put a little into crypto. One of my students laughed and said he couldn’t believe I finally did it...but damn it, I want to see @dogecoin grow so I don’t regret it later. (We are prepared to lose what we invested.) It’s kind of a thrill, though!
